RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

8. 
To add or remove rows: 

• 
To add a task to the close checklist, click the 
 Add button. 

• 
To remove a task from the close checklist, click the 
 Remove button. 

Assignments 

Use the Assignments section to assign the tasks to different locations and accountants. Complete 

each row as follows: 

1. 
From the Location drop-down list, select the location. 

2. 
From the Accountant drop-down list, select an accountant. 

3. 
To add or remove rows: 

• 
To add a location or accountant to the task, click the 
 Add button. 

• 
To remove a location or accountant from the task, click the 
 Remove button. 

A location can have multiple close checklists. 

You can also import a file with the location and accountant assignment information. 

1. 
To download the Checklist Assignment template, click the Download checklist assignment 

template link. Your browser downloads the Excel file. Open the Excel file to edit it. 

Depending upon the browser you are using, you may have to save the Excel file before 
opening it. 

2. 
Save the completed Excel spreadsheet. 

3. 
In the Upload Assignment (CSV) section, click the Choose file button. The Open dialog box 

opens. 

4. 
Locate the Excel spreadsheet you completed, and then click Open. The name of the Excel 

file is now listed in the Upload Assignment (CSV) section. 

5. 
Click the Upload button. The data from the Excel file is populated into the assignment table.

*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 115*

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Using the Finance Agent 

Finance Agent is a centralized workspace that brings together your AI-powered accounting tools into one 

streamlined application. Instead of jumping between separate modules or manual processes, Finance Agent uses 

intelligent automation to help you review, process, and manage financial activity with greater speed and accuracy. 

Designed to simplify complex accounting tasks, Finance Agent analyzes data, identifies patterns, and assists with 

decision-making—whether you’re approving invoices, reviewing variances, or monitoring financial performance. 

By combining multiple AI-driven functions into a single interface, it reduces administrative effort and gives you 

clearer insight into your organization’s financial health.

### AI-Invoice Intake
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 119*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

AI-Invoice Intake 

You can load a file containing invoice data to have the system use AI to analyze the file and turn it 

into an invoice record.  

Loading the Invoice Data 

When you load a file with invoice information, the system uses AI to analyze the file and create a 

new invoice using the data from the uploaded file. When the file has multiple pages with separate 

invoices on each page, the pages are separated and an invoice is created for each page.  

You can load the invoice file using three methods: 

• 
Scanning: Scan an invoice with a scanning device to add it to the queue. 

• 
Emailing: Send invoice files to the email address that your company defined during 

configuration (on page 27). It is the address that ends with @ap.realpage.com. 

• 
Importing: Import an invoice file from your computer. 

Required Data 

The A/P invoices that you add to the system using AI must contain the following data: 

• 
Date 

• 
Vendor 

• 
Invoice number 

• 
Total invoice amount 

• 
Due date 

Line items must contain: 

• 
Location 

• 
Either Price or Amount must be included.  

How AI Matches Invoices to Properties 

As the system creates an invoice record, it tries to match the property name on the invoice with 

the entity name in the system. If it does not match the entity name, it checks the Property name 

field of the entity record. This is the field where the property’s alias is stored. If it does not match 

the entity name or the property name, the system checks the address. 

It will also search on likeness. If the entity in the system is “Glenview Living Apartments” and 

“Glenview Living” is shown on the invoice, the system will match the two because they are similar. 

This method is also used when matching vendor records.  

The AI agent removes special characters from names and addresses before the matching process 

and ignores case sensitivity in names and addresses. 

---


<!-- Page 120 -->
Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

How the AI Agent Matches Entity Name and Addresses 

When the AI agent receives an invoice, it scans the information and compares the invoice details 

to the corresponding entity name, property name, and the Ship to property address. 

If the invoice has only one address, the AI agent compares the address on the invoice to the Ship 

to address in the entity record in the system. 

If the invoice has two addresses, the AI agent: 

a) First checks the name and address in the Ship to area on the invoice to find a match with an 

entity record in the system.  

b) If it does not find a match, the AI agent checks if the other name on the invoice matches an 

entity in the system.  

How the AI Agent Matches the Vendor 

When the AI agent receives an invoice, it compares the vendor name on the invoice and tries to 

get a 90% match with the vendor name in the system. It does not require an exact match to 

identify the vendor name. The AI agent also tries to match the vendor’s address. 

Utility and Telecommunications Invoices 

The system can recognize an invoice for utility or telecommunication services when the vendor’s 

Vendor type field is set to “utility” or “Utility type.” 

When you email, upload, or scan invoices into the system, and it detects an invoice for utility or 

telecommunication services, the system processes them differently.  

• 
For utility vendors, the system sets the Do not itemize option automatically so that only the 

total amount is coded.  

• 
If the system finds an account number on the invoice, it sets the Invoice number field to the 

account number. 

• 
If the system finds service dates, it sets the Invoice number field to the account number 

plus service date range.  

---


<!-- Page 121 -->
Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Attachments 

When a document includes multiple invoices, the system automatically separates the PDF into 

individual invoice documents. Each extracted invoice is attached only to its corresponding invoice 

record. 

• 
Multi-invoice PDFs are automatically split into individual invoice files. 

• 
Each invoice record receives only the attachment that belongs to it. 

G/L Accounts 

The system uses historical data to code the items with a G/L account.  

When the system processes a new A/P invoice, it reviews previously entered invoices for the same 

vendor and item descriptions, and identifies patterns in how the invoices have been coded for the 

vendor. Using this historical data, the system suggests the most frequently used G/L accounts, 

and automatically pre-sets the GL account to the most likely account. 

The system presents a list of suggested G/L accounts for each line item. 

The system runs this same process on eInvoices. 

Line Items 

The system creates a line item for each charge. The system identifies a credit when it detects 

“Credit memo” in the invoice data. When the system identifies a credit, it creates a line item with a 

negative amount. 

If you prefer, you can enable the Do not itemize invoice option to have the system create one 

line item per invoice. You can turn on this option for all invoices, or by vendor only.  

• 
To turn on the feature system wide, see Scanning Invoices Without Itemization (on page 

118).  

• 
To control the option not to itemize for one vendor, see Adding Vendor Records. 

---


<!-- Page 122 -->
Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Submitting or Posting 

When the auto post option is enabled and the loaded invoice contains all of the required data, 

the system automatically submits the invoices for review and approval. If approvals are not 

enabled, then the system posts the invoices. 

If the required fields are incomplete, then the system creates the invoice records and saves them 

as drafts. 

You can change this setting in Company > AI Configuration. Find the AI Invoice Scanning section, 

and then select or clear the Automatically submit or post AI Invoices if all required information 

is defined check box.

How the AI Agent Fills In Missing Information 

If you do not predefine a G/L account, and the AI agent does not find one on the invoice, then the 

AI agent checks if there are any previous invoices for the same vendor with the same items, and 

with a similar memo. If the AI agent finds a matching invoice, then the system automatically codes 

the new invoice based on the historical invoice. 

On the invoice, the system creates a Suggested G/L section that contains a list of G/L accounts that 

have been used previously on invoices for this vendor. The section includes suggested G/L 

accounts for each line item. 

If the AI agent doesn’t find any prior invoices with G/L accounts, then the system uses the default 

expense account from the vendor. If the vendor does not have a default expense account, then 

the system sets the default expense account for online shopping, if enabled. 

Scanning Invoices into the System 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Accounts Payable > All > Daily Tasks > AI-Invoice Queue > Add > Scan`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > AI Invoicing > AI Invoice Queue > Add > Scan`

• 
You must have a scanner configured to work with your system. Enable scanning in your 

preferences. 

• 
You must have the AI-Invoice Queue - Run permission to scan and import invoices using 

the AI feature. 

• 
AI-Invoice scanning must be enabled on the Company application’s AI Configuration 

powered by Lumina page. 

To scan invoices into the system using the AI-Invoice feature: 

1. 
Open the Accounts Payable menu. 

2. 
In the Daily Tasks section, select the AI-Invoice Queue option. 

3. 
Click the Add button, and then select Scan. The AI-Invoice Scanning box opens. 

4. 
You can predefine the vendor, location, or G/L account for the invoices that you are 

importing instead of having AI extract the information from the invoice image. Select the 

desired information that you want to define: 

• 
Select the vendor associated with the invoice that you plan to scan from the Vendor 

drop-down list. If you do not select a vendor, then the system will use AI to retrieve 

the vendor from the invoice image and add it to the invoice record.

“1-2.” 

• 
Type a comma to denote a page separation. 

• 
Type the next page number or page range for the second invoice in the file, and then 

type a comma. 

• 
Continue in this way until all invoices in the file are represented.  

• 
Click the Save & Separate button. 

A success message displays: 

“Separated invoices are being reprocessed. They will appear in the AI Invoice Queue once 

completed.”

#### Reviewing AI-Invoices
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 131*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Reviewing AI-Invoices 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Accounts Payable > All > Daily Tasks > AI-Invoice Queue > Review`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > AI Invoicing > AI Invoice Queue > Review`


To review AI-scanned invoices: 

1. 
Open the Accounts Payable menu. 

2. 
In the Daily Tasks section, click the AI-Invoice queue option. 

3. 
Click the Review button. The AI-Invoice Scanning page opens, displaying the invoice record 

on one side, and the scanned (or imported) image on the other side.  

4. 
Make any needed corrections and additions. 

You can archive the invoice, post the invoice, save the invoice, or if approvals are enabled, 

submit the invoice for approval. 

Finishing the Review 

To finish a review, you can either archive the invoice, post or submit the invoice, or save the 

invoice. 

• 
Click the Archive button to archive the invoice. 

• 
To post the invoice, select Post & Next. To skip this invoice and display the next invoice in 

the queue, click the Post & Next down arrow, and then click Next. This button appears only 

if the approval workflow is disabled for A/P invoices. 

• 
To submit the invoice for approval, select Submit & Next. To skip this invoice and display 

the next invoice in the queue, click the Submit & Next down arrow, and then click Next.  

This option appears only when the approval workflow is enabled for A/P invoices. If your 
account has been granted the Bypass Transaction Approval - A/P Invoice permission, then 
the Post & Next button appears instead of the Submit & Next button. 

• 
To save the invoice, select Save & Next. You can skip this invoice by clicking the Save & 

Next down arrow and then clicking Next. 

---



#### Editing AI-Invoices
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 132*

Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide

Editing AI-Invoices 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Accounts Payable > All > Daily Tasks > AI-Invoice Queue > Edit`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > AI Invoicing > AI Invoice Queue > Edit`


To edit an AI scanned-in invoice: 

1. 
Open the Accounts Payable menu. 

2. 
In the Daily Tasks section, click the AI-Invoice queue option. 

3. 
Find the invoice that you want to change, and then click the Edit link. 

4. 
Make the desired changes. 

Finalizing the Edited Invoice 

• 
To post the invoice, select Post & Next. You can also click the Post & Next down arrow, and 

then click Next.  

• 
To submit the invoice for approval, click the Submit & Next button. You can also click the 

Submit & Next down arrow, and then click Next.  

This option appears only when the approval workflow is enabled for A/P invoices. If your 
account has been granted the Bypass Transaction Approval - A/P Invoice permission, then 
the Post & Next button appears instead of the Submit & Next button. 

• 
To save the invoice, select Save & Next. You can also click the Save & Next down arrow, and 

then click Next. Use this option when you want to submit the invoice later.  

• 
To archive the changed invoice, click the Archive button. This option hides the invoice from 

view in the queue, letting you focus on invoices that need to be reviewed now. You can 

include archived invoices in the list by selecting the Show archived check box above the list.

them by selecting the Show archived check box.

flagged with an ARCHIVED tag.

#### Deleting AI-Invoices from the Queue
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 135*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent

Deleting AI-Invoices from the Queue 


> **Navigation Path:** `Accounts Payable > Daily Tasks > AI-Invoice Queue > (select) > Delete`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > AI Invoicing > AI Invoice Queue > (select) > 
Delete`


You can delete invoices to remove them from the queue permanently.  

To delete invoices from the queue: 

1. 
Open the Accounts Payable menu.  

2. 
In the Daily Tasks section, click AI-Invoice Queue. 

3. 
For each invoice that you want to delete, click the Delete check box to the right of the 

invoice row.  

4. 
After selecting all of the invoices that you want to delete, click the Delete button. The 

system removes the invoices from the queue.  

You can also delete an invoice while reviewing it. 

1. 
To review an invoice from the AI-Invoice Queue list, click the View link of the desired 

invoice. 

2. 
Click the Delete & Next button. The system deletes the current invoice and then displays 

the next invoice in the queue.

create vendor records for them in the system. This field is required.

Return to 
Select the vendor contact to whom you want to send a return of the

If it is not filled in, then the system uses the contact associated with the 

vendor that you selected on this page. In most cases, you won’t need to 

override the default, but you can override it as needed. As an example, 

when returning a defective product, the vendor may request that you 

return it to a location other than the one on record. 

State 
The state of the invoice: 

• 
Submitted: The invoice is saved and submitted to the approval 

workflow. 

• 
Declined: Approvers declined the invoice. 

• 
Selected: The invoice is selected for payment but not yet paid. 

• 
Draft: The invoice is saved but not yet posted or submitted for 

approval. 

• 
Posted: The invoice is posted to the General Ledger. 

• 
Partially paid: Only part of the invoice is paid. 

• 
Partially approved: A transaction can have more than one 

approver. The invoice is approved by at least one approver in 

the workflow, but more approvals are required. 

• 
Paid: The invoice is paid in full. 

• 
Reversed: The invoice has been reversed. 

• 
Reversal: The listed transaction is the reversal created from the 

reversed invoice.

### AI-Invoice Upload Audit List
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 149*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

AI-Invoice Upload Audit List 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Accounts Payable > All > Daily Tasks > AI-Invoice Upload Audit`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > AI Invoicing > AI Invoice Upload Audit`


Use this list to monitor and troubleshoot AI-Invoice processing issues. From this list, you can 

monitor the sources of invoices being submitted, the time that the invoices were submitted, and 

who submitted them.  

You must be an administrator to view this list. The AI-Invoice Upload Audit list is also available to 

administrators in Site View. 

 In this list, you can: 

• 
Click the 
 Attachment button to open the processed invoice image. 

• 
Find out more information about processing failures by clicking the Failed link in the Result 

column. 

Possible results include: 

• 
Success: The invoice image is successfully added to the system.  

• 
Failed: The invoice was not added to the system. Click the Failed link to find out why. Click 

the 
 Attachment button so that you can display and download the invoice. 

• 
Submitted: The invoice is being uploaded and is pending processing by the AI agent. 

What to Do When an Invoice Fails 

The Result column shows Failed when an invoice fails to upload. 

When an invoice fails, you can: 

• 
Click the Retry upload link to have the AI agent try to process the invoice again. 

• 
Click the Failed link to review the reason for the failure. If the invoice failed due to missing 

required information, contact the vendor to get an updated invoice. 

• 
Contact RealPage support with the downloaded failed invoice and the error message. Click 

the Failed link to get the error message. Click the 
 Attachment button to display and 

download the invoice so that you can give it to the support representative. 

---

Troubleshooting AI-Processed Invoices 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Accounts Payable > All > Daily Tasks > AI-Invoice Upload Audit`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > AI Invoicing > AI Invoice Upload Audit`


When you scan or upload an invoice and it does not appear in the queue, you can check the 

AI-Invoice Upload Audit list to gather information about why the invoice processing failed.  

Only administrators can access the AI-Invoice Upload Audit list. 

To use the audit list for troubleshooting: 

1. 
Open the Accounts Payable menu. 

2. 
In the Daily Tasks section, click the AI-Invoice Upload Audit option. 

3. 
Review the list for pertinent details: 

• 
Check the Result column to see if the invoice processing failed.  

• 
If an invoice failed, click the Failed link to view the system message about the failure. 

The message often provides the reason for the failure. 

• 
In the Uploaded by column, find out who uploaded the invoice. You can use the email 

address to contact the user to get more information about the invoice as needed. 

• 
Collect details about the failed invoices, such as invoice number, amount, and the date 

it was scanned. 

Invoices without a Property 

When the AI agent cannot identify the property associated with an invoice, the AI agent creates 

the invoice and puts it in the AI-Invoice queue list. Only users who have the AI-Invoice Queue 

permission View invoices with no property defined can see these invoices.

Financial Close Section 

This section describes how to use the Financial Close menu options of the Finance Agent menu.  

Workbench 

The Workbench command opens the Financial Close workbench with a list of your tasks that 

need to be completed. 

Workbench Page 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Financial Close Management > All > Workbench`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Financial Close > Workbench`


Use the Workbench page to provide accountants with a list of tasks that need to be completed. 

From the Financial Suite Home page, click the Applications drop-down list, select Financial close 

management, and then click Workbench in the All tab. 

To view the Workbench page, you must have the List permission under Tasks. See Before You 
Begin (on page 72 ) for more information about Tasks permissions. 

As shown in the example below, the Workbench page includes the name, type, approver, and 

reviewer for each task. 

---


<!-- Page 155 -->
Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

On the Workbench page, you can perform any of the following actions: 

a) Apply or Clear: Use one of these buttons to either apply filtering criteria to the search 

results or clear any filtering criteria for broader search results. 

b) Apply view: Select a saved view from the drop-down list. 

c) Complete / Incomplete / Delete: Select one or more tasks, and then click one of these 

buttons to determine the flow and status of the selected tasks. 

d) Action URL links: Use one of the links to determine the flow or comment on the selected 

tasks. 

e) Update View/Save view as: Use the Save View As button to save any changes you make to 

the view and assign it a new name. Use the Update View button to save a view that had 

already been saved.

#### Workbench Actions
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 157*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Workbench Actions 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Financial Close Management > All > Workbench`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Financial Close > Workbench`


You can perform additional actions from the results table on the Workbench page. 

To complete a workbench task: 

1. 
Open the Financial Close Management or Finance Agent menu, and then click Workbench. 

2. 
From the Workbench page results, select a task with an Incomplete status from the results 

table. 

3. 
Select the check box for the task you want to complete, and then click the Complete button. 

The Close Checklist box opens. See Close Checklist Box (on page 150) for more information. 

• 
Alternatively, click the Complete link in the task row. The Close Checklist box opens. 

You can add optional comments before clicking the Complete button. 

• 
You can also click the Comment link in the task row. The Close Checklist box opens. 

You must add comments before clicking the Complete button. 

To change a complete task to incomplete: 

1. 
From the Workbench page results, select a task with a Complete status from the results 

table. 

2. 
Select the check box for the task for which you want to change the status to Incomplete, 

and then click the Incomplete button. 

To reverse the status of a task, the task must be assigned to you with a Complete status.

• 
Alternatively, click the Comment link in the task row. The Close Checklist box opens. 

You must add comments before clicking the Complete button. 

To delete a workbench task: 

1. 
From the Workbench page results, select a task you want to delete from the results table. 

2. 
Select the check box for the task, and then click the Delete button. 

To delete a task, the task must be assigned to you with an Incomplete status or you must 
be set up as an Unrestricted user.

your entities or locations complete their month-end or year-end close procedures. You must have 

a work paper configuration set up before you can generate work papers. See Work Paper 

Configuration List Page (on page 54) for more information.

b) Locations: Use this section to choose a location after you apply the filters.

d) Cancel: Click this button to cancel the work paper generation process and go back to the 

Financial close management home page.

Generating a Work Paper Package 

Use the Generate work papers page to generate a work paper package. There are two modes of 

work paper packages: 

• 
Preliminary mode lets you review the reconciled work papers to ensure that they compiled 

correctly and that they balance. Tabs for work papers that should balance are color-coded 

to make them easier to review. Preliminary work paper packages do not include cover 

sheets or Custom Work Sheets (CWS). 

• 
Final mode lets you submit a polished work paper package for review. You can attach 

additional tabs such as cover sheets and work instructions if they are not already included 

as part of the configuration.

Work Paper 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Financial Close Management > All > Activities > Work Paper`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Activities > Work Paper`


The Work papers page allows you to download work paper packages and submit final work paper 

packages for approval. Reviewers and approvers use this page to download and approve work 

paper packages.  

You can use this page to upload additional tabs to final work paper packages or upload 

replacement work paper packages for the ones generated by the system. For example, if you add 

several tabs throughout a work paper package to mark sections, upload the entire package rather 

than several tabs. 

a) Filters: Use either the drop-down list or the column filter to view specific work papers. 

b) Status: Click either the Pending Review or Completed status to view the work paper 

approval history. 

c) Lock/Unlock: Final work papers in Completed status are locked and may not be edited. 

d) Common Tasks: There are two sections of common tasks. 

• 
The first section involves a set of action tasks: Download to save the final work papers 

in Excel, Generate to create the final work papers for download, or Re-Generate to 

generate any of the final work papers again to download in Excel. 

• 
The second section involves a set of review tasks for final work papers: Upload to add 

attachments, History to view the revision history, or Re-set to regenerate the final 

work papers.

Downloading and Viewing a Work Paper Package 

You can download any work paper package on the Work papers page. To download a work paper 

package, click the Download link next to the work paper package you want to download. Your 

browser downloads the Excel file. Open the Excel file to view it. 

Additionally, you can click the Select column check box at the beginning of one or more rows. 

When you have selected all invoices to download, click the Download button in the upper left 

corner of the page. A Save As dialog box opens, requesting you to save the zip file to your 

computer. 

Depending on the browser you are using, you may have to save the Excel file before opening it.

Viewing Preliminary and Final Work Paper Packages in Excel 

Preliminary and final work paper packages appear differently in Excel. Preliminary work paper 

packages have additional features for simplifying analysis, while final work paper packages are 

designed to be a polished final version for review.

### Work Paper Approval Process
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 192*

Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Work Paper Approval Process 

Financial Close Management helps facilitate the review process for your work papers by providing 

email notifications to reviewers and allowing you to track the status of work papers. You can also 

view the status history for work papers that are in review or completed. Use the Work papers 

page to access information about ongoing reviews or to review status history. 

There are three roles in the work paper approval process: 

• 
Preparer: This person generates the work paper package and submits it to the reviewer for 

approval. 

• 
Reviewer: This person provides the first-level review of the work paper package and submits 

it to the approver for final approval. 

• 
Approver: This person grants final approval of the work paper package. 

The reviewer and the approver can be the same person, in which case the process shortens to 

require only one approval. 

The reviewer and the approver are designated as part of the work paper configuration process. If 

necessary, a proxy reviewer can be added as an unrestricted user by an administrator. See Adding 

Unrestricted Users for more information. 

---

there are work papers pending their review. 

3.

package. The Work paper approval history box opens. This box displays a list of updates to 

the state of the work papers within the approval process.

*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 195*

*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 195*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Approving Work Papers 

To approve work papers: 

1. 
Click the Approve link for the work paper package. The Approve work paper box opens. 

2. 
Optionally, type comments regarding the approval into the Comments field. 

3. 
Click Approve. The box closes, and the work papers are removed from the Needs Attention 

filter on the Work papers page. 

When you select All from the Filter by drop-down list, the work papers you approved 

appear with an updated status as follows: 

• 
If the work papers were approved by a Reviewer and are pending approval from an 

Approver, the work papers appear with a status of Reviewed. 

• 
If this was the final approval level, the work papers appear with a Completed status, 

and the work papers are locked. 

Declining Work Papers 

To decline work papers: 

1. 
Click the Decline link for the work paper package. The Decline Work Paper box opens. 

2. 
Optionally, type comments regarding the rejection into the Comments field. 

3. 
Click Decline. The box closes, and the work papers are removed from the Needs Attention 

filter on the Work Papers page. 

When you select All from the Filter By drop-down list, the work papers you rejected appear 

with a Declined status. Additionally, the Preparer receives notification of the rejection. 

Regenerating Work Papers That Were Declined 

If the reviewer declines your work papers, you receive an email notifying you that your work 

papers were declined. You must update the work papers and resubmit them to the reviewer for 

approval. 

If the reviewer approves the work papers and the approver declines them, both the reviewer and 

the Preparer receive notification of the rejection. Depending on the reasoning behind the 

rejection and your standard business processes: 

• 
The reviewer can upload attachments or regenerate the work papers. The Preparer for the 

work papers is updated to the reviewer’s name, and the reviewer can click the Approve link 

to resubmit to the approver for approval.

### Agent Jobs

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide

Agent Jobs 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Agent Jobs`


The AI Agent Jobs function lets you automates tasks associated with period end closings, such as 

closing books for A/P, G/L, A/R, and Cash Management. The AI agent ties the jobs directly the 

Close Checklist workflow. 

This AI agent streamlines the financial close process by: 

• 
Automating repetitive period end tasks 

• 
Ensuring checklist accuracy and consistency 

• 
Enforcing period-based controls 

• 
Providing visibility into job execution history 

• 
Reducing manual effort and risk of missed close activities 

How It Works 

When an agent job is created, the system automatically generates a corresponding Close 

Checklist entry.  

• 
The checklist name concatenates the job type, period, and location. 

• 
Checklist items created through Finance Agent are read-only and can only be edited from 

the Agent Jobs list. 

Using the AI Jobs Agent 

Select the Agent Jobs menu option to open the Agent Jobs page. Use the Agent Jobs page to 

create jobs that run on a monthly schedule. You can also create individual jobs on this page. 

Use the filters Year, Month, Job, and Property/Property Group to limit the number of jobs 

displayed in the list on the page.

#### Running a Job
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 205*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Running a Job 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Agent Jobs > Run`


Jobs are designed to run automatically based on the As of date. For example, you can set up one 

month to close on the 25th and the next month, close on the 26th because the 25th is over the 

weekend. The dates can change from month to month. 

You can also run a job manually from the Agent Jobs page. 

To run a job manually: 

1. 
Open the Finance Agent menu. 

2. 
Click the Agent Jobs menu option. 

3. 
Filter to find the job that you want to run. You can filter by: 

• 
Year 

• 
Month 

• 
Job 

• 
Property/Property group 

4. 
Click the Apply button to see the results of the filter. 

5. 
Find the job that you want to run. 

If desired, you can change the As of date of the job. 

6. 
Click the Run link. When the job completes, the system shows a message: “Job ran 

successfully” and the date that it ran appears in the Last Run Date column in the Agent Jobs 

list. 

If the job does not have a Run link, then the job is not eligible to be run. For example, if the 
job has already been run for the selected time period, then the Run link does not appear. 

Successful job runs automatically complete the associated checklist task. 

If a job fails (such as when the books are already closed), the system displays a clear error 

message and logs the failure.

### Missing Expenses
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 213*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Missing Expenses 

Missing expenses are unrecorded costs due to timing delays, typically because the invoice hasn’t 

arrived. Without accruals, missing expenses would cause understated liabilities and overstated 

profits. Accruals correct this by recognizing the expense in the correct period—even if the cash 

hasn’t left the account yet.  

Prerequisites 

• 
The missing expenses feature uses standard vendors set on an entity. See Set your standard 

vendors (on page 38) for instructions. 

• 
To receive accrual emails, you must be assigned to the Finance Agent - Automated Accrual 

Notifications role. 

How It Works 

• 
The AI agent continuously searches for missing expenses and when found, adds them to the 

Missing Expenses list.  

• 
You select the missing expenses in the list that you want the AI agent to accrue, set the 

posting date and email address, and click Post Accruals. 

• 
The AI agent runs an offline process to calculate the accruals and post them. The system 

then sends an email to notify you when the posting is complete. 

• 
The accrual entries reverse automatically on the first of the next month, and the system 

sends an email when the reversal is completed. 

---


<!-- Page 214 -->
Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

a) 
Last Invoice Date Link: Opens the invoice associated with the expense. 

b) 
Calculate Accrual Button: Expands the missing expenses to accrue section. 

c) 
Done Button: Closes the list and returns to the Finance Agent Home page. 

d) 
Export Button: Saves the missing expenses in the selected file format. 

Action Cards 

You can add action cards to your Home page to alert you to newly identified missing expenses.

#### Setting Up Multi Month Missing Expenses Notification
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 216*

Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Setting Up Multi Month Missing Expenses Notification 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > Setup > AI Configuration > Automated Actions > Notify 
Me of Missing Expenses From Two Months Ago`


You can have the system notify you if you have not received an invoice for a vendor for multiple 

months. When you receive the notification, you may want to reach out to the vendor.  

Requirements 

Your company must subscribe to the Finance Agent application. 

Procedure 

To set up missing expenses notifications: 

1. 
Open the Finance Agent menu, and then click the Setup tab of the menu. 

2. 
Select AI Configuration. 

3. 
In the Automated Actions section, select the Notify me of missing expenses from two 

months check box. This option is enabled by default.  

4. 
Click Save. 

The AI agent monitors the system expenses that have been missing for a vendor/entity 

combination for two months in a row. When the system finds missing expenses for 

vendor/entity combinations, it sends an email to all users who are assigned to the 

Automated Accrual Notifications role. The system sends the email on the last day of the 

month. The email contains the following information: 

Email Subject: Finance Agent has completed processing your bank statements 

Email Text: Your Lumina Finance Agent has found that you haven’t received an invoice for 

the following vendors in the last two months.  

VendorID--VendorID and EntityID--EntityName

Agent Accruals List 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Accounts Payable > Agent Accruals`


Agent Accruals helps simplify the accrual process by using AI to identify missing expenses and 

create accruals. The AI agent accrues missing expenses for standard vendors, those that you 

receive bills from regularly such as utilities or telecom providers. 

Before you can use this feature, you must define your standard vendors and then associate the 

vendors with the appropriate entities. Additional configuration is required to define how and 

when accruals are calculated. When you complete the configuration, the AI agent creates an 

accrual template that it uses to accrue missing expenses from the standard vendors. After the AI 

agent processes accruals of missing expenses from standard vendors, you can review and edit 

them in the Agent Accruals list. 

a) Edit: Change an accrual. 

b) View: Review an accrual’s details. 

c) Delete: Delete an accrual template. 

d) Done: Close the list and return to the Finance Agent Home page. 

e) Export: Save the list of accruals as a CSV or Excel file. 

Before You Begin 

Access can vary depending on your organization’s subscriptions and your permissions. If you do 

not see the option in the menu, then ask your System Administrator to check your permissions.

Configuring Automated Accruals 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > Setup > AI Configuration > Automated Accruals >  
Add`


To create an automated accrual: 

1. 
Open the Finance Agent menu. 

2. 
Select the Setup tab of the menu. 

3. 
Select AI Configuration. 

4. 
Find the Automated Accruals section. 

5. 
Click the 
 Add at the end of a row to add a new blank row. 

6. 
In the Standard Vendor Type drop-down list, select the vendor type for which you want to 

create an accrual template. 

7. 
In the Debit Account drop-down list, select a G/L account for the accrual entry. 

8. 
In the Credit Account drop-down list, select a G/L account for the accrual entry.  

9. 
In the Run Date drop-down list, select the desired day of the month to run the accrual 

calculation, 1 through 31 or Last day of the month. If you select 31, the accrual runs on the 

last day of every month. 

10. 
In the Calculate For drop-down list, select whether you want to calculate accruals for the 

Current period or for the Prior period. 

11. 
Select the Post check box if you want to post the accruals automatically after calculating 

them. If you do not select the option to post automatically, then you can use the Accruals 

workbench (on page 218) to review accruals before posting them. 

12. 
Select Active or Inactive from the Status drop-down list. Active is the default setting.  

13. 
Click Save.  

After the configuration is saved, the system creates an accrual template. The first column 

shows the automated accrual ID which is composed of “Invoices Not Received for” and the 

vendor type. This text is linked to the accrual template. When clicked, the system opens the 

accrual template record where you can make changes as needed. 

Receiving Emails after an AI Agent Accrual 

To receive an email from the system after the AI agent accrues an expense, you must be assigned 

to the Finance Agent - Automated Accrual Notification role.

### Accrual Workbench
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 228*

Accrual Workbench 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > General Ledger > All > Periodic Tasks > Accrual > Accrual Workbench`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Accounts Payable > Accrual Workbench`


The Accrual workbench contains accrual information based on accrual templates. 

Use the Accrual workbench to filter and search for calculated accruals. You can view the 

suggested accruals, select what you want to accrue, and then post the accruals. After an accrual is 

posted, the system creates a reversing entry. The reversal date defaults to the first day of the next 

month. You can change the reversal date in the Reversal Date field.  

Using the Accrual Workbench with the AI Finance Agent 

If your company subscribes to the AI Finance Agent, the workbench contains accrual information 

based on accrual templates that the AI Finance Agent creates in addition to any accrual templates 

that you created manually. Note that only the Accrual workbench in the Finance Agent application 

includes both regular and AI agent-processed accruals. 

Use the Accrual workbench to find accruals that the AI agent has calculated.  

• 
Use the filters for Property, Accrual for (month), or an Accrual ID and then click Apply to find 

the calculated accruals.  

• 
Click the Amount in the list to view the missing expenses for the vendor.  

• 
After you validate the accrual, you can post it here by selecting the accrual, and then clicking 

the Post button. The system posts an accrual entry based on the accrual template and then 

reverses it on the first day of the next month. 

• 
Use the Accrual Activity report to check which missing expenses that the AI agent calculated 

or posted, and the date it occurred. 

You can receive an email from the system when accruals are calculated or posted when you are 
assigned to the Finance Agent - Automated Accrual Notifications role. 

---


<!-- Page 229 -->
Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

The Accrual workbench is divided into two sections: Filters and the list. 

a) Filters: The top section contains options that allow you to filter for the accruals that you 

want to work with.  

b) List Controls: These controls affect what happens to the accruals in the bottom section. The 

Calculate, Post, Unpost, and Delete buttons act on the selected expenses in the list. The 

Refresh button updates the list with any new expenses that match your filters. 

c) List of expenses to accrue: After you click the Apply button, the list of expenses that fall 

within your filter settings appear in the bottom section. Use this section to select the 

expenses that you want to act on (Calculate, Post, Unpost, or Delete).  

d) Save View As: When you have the filters set to retrieve accruals that you want to use again 

later, save the settings in a view.  

e) Export: Exports the list of expenses that appear in the list in the selected file format.  

f) 
Done: Closes the workbench and returns to the application’s home page. 

You can also: 

• 
Click the text in the Accrual ID column to open the accrual template. 

• 
Click the number in the Amount column to open the Calculated Accruals box. 

• 
Click the number in the Journal Entry column to open the journal entries associated 

with the accrual.

<!-- Page 241 -->

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Interpreting the Calculate Accruals Box 

The box shows how the system calculates the accrual amount. The accrual template determines 

the calculation: 

• 
Invoices Not Received accrual template. The amount is based on the last invoice amount. 

The box lists the last invoice that the system uses to base the accrual amount on. 

• 
Invoices Not Received accrual template.  

The accrual amount is the average of the last three invoices. The box lists the invoices that it 

used to calculate the amount. The system uses the last three invoices, but if there are only 

two invoices in the system, it averages the two invoices that it has to calculate the accrual 

amount. 

---


<!-- Page 242 -->
Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

• 
Invoices Advanced accrual template. The system evaluates three invoice attributes: 

• 
The invoice must have an invoice date that is prior to the posting date of the first of 

the month after the accrual period. 

• 
Invoices must fall into the Account To/From range specified in the template. 

• 
Invoices must be selected for accrual in this box. 

The system sums the items that meet the criteria, and then uses the total as the accrual 

amount. 

• 
Invoices Not Received accrual template. When you post the accrual to the General Ledger, 

it posts with the fixed amount that is specified in the template. 

• 
G/L Posting Date: If the account was credited in an advanced journal entry, then the system 

evaluates the credit line items of the accounts in the accrual template in the invoice.

### Agent Payments
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 245*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Agent Payments 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Accounts Payable > Agent Payments`


The Agent Payments feature uses AI to create payment requests to vendors from whom you 

receive invoices regularly. After the system creates the payment requests, you can continue 

processing the payment requests by reviewing and submitting them for approval, printing and 

confirming checks, and so on. 

How It Works 

The AI agent creates payment requests for standard expenses automatically, and then sends you 

an email to notify you that the payment requests have been created so that you can review and 

make the payments. The system processes the payment requests starting at 3 am CST on the date 

that you designate as the Start date. 

Configuration 

• 
Standard Vendors: You must configure your standard vendors before you can set up 

automatic payments. Standard vendors send your company an invoice on a regular basis, 

such as for utilities or telecommunication services. To set up the standard vendors for your 

entities, see Setting Up Standard Vendor Types (on page 38). 

• 
Payment schedule: Configure a payment schedule for each regular invoice that you receive 

from a standard vendor. For each vendor, you define the method of payment to use, the 

bank account to pay from, the date that you want to start automatic payments, and the 

frequency of the payments. See Configuring a New Automatic Payment Schedule (on page 

48). 

Prerequisites 

• 
To receive an email from the system when it completes the processing of automated 

payments, a user account must be assigned to the Finance Agent – Automated Payment 

Notifications role. 

Agent Payments List 

Use the Agent payments list (on page 238) to see the list of scheduled payments. 

---

### Contracts
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 255*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Contracts 

Use the Contracts menu option on the Finance Agent menu to open the Contracts list, where you 

can add and manage contracts, purchase orders, subcontracts, and service contracts. 

The system uses an AI agent to scan contracts for clauses and keywords that you chose during 

configuration. The AI contract scanning feature allows you to define keywords that the AI agent 

uses to automatically identify and extract contract clauses—such as management agreements and 

vendor contracts—so that you don’t have to read through the full document to find the 

information.  

Configuration 

By configuring keywords on the AI Configuration page, you enable the system to scan uploaded 

contracts and pull out any clauses that contain those terms. This streamlines clause management 

by ensuring that key sections of a contract are captured without manual review. See Adding 

Clauses and Keywords to AI Contract Screening (on page 30). 

After configuration, whenever you add a new contract, the system scans the contract for the 

clauses and keywords that you configured and then adds the text to the Clause tab of the 

Contract Information page.

required field. 

5.

In the Tax field, type the amount of tax on the contract.

Contract types are customizable.  

8. 
In the Description field, type a description of the contract and its purpose. 

9. 
In the Shipping field, type the amount associated with shipping.

In the Contract text field, type or paste the text of the contract. 

Filling In the Title Section 

1. 
In the Title field, type the title of the contract. This is a required field. 

2. 
In the Start date field, type the date that work starts against the contract. 

3. 
In the End date field, type the date that work associated with the contract ends. 

4. 
In the Awarded Bid ID field, type the unique identifier that is associated with the bid. 

5. 
In the Effective date field, type the date that the contract takes effect. 

6. 
In the Approved date field, type the date that the contract is approved. 

7. 
In the Approved by field, type the name of the person who approved the contract. 

8. 
In the Executed by vendor on field, type the date that the vendor signed the contract.  

9. 
In the Contract reference number field, type the reference number from an external source 

associated with the contract. 

10. 
In the Executed on field, type the date that the contract was signed. 

11.

#### Setting Up the Contract Expiration Alert
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 274*

Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Setting Up the Contract Expiration Alert 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Company > All > Ledger Sentry > Alerts and Notifications`


A contract expiration alert helps you stay ahead of upcoming contract deadlines by sending a 

reminder as an email notification before the contract’s expiration date or due date arrives. You 

can set up this alert to give you enough time to review terms, renew the agreement, or take any 

required action before the contract lapses. By setting up this notification, you can proactively 

manage contract timelines and avoid missed renewals or service interruptions. 

Prerequisite 

Before you begin, set up a role to use for contract expiration notifications. The users assigned to 

this role will receive a reminder by email when a contract is about to expire.  

To set up the contract expiration notification: 

1. 
Open the Company menu, and select the Ledger sentry option. 

2. 
In the Ledger sentry page, find the Alerts and notifications section. 

Click the 
 Add button to add a row for the new alert if needed. 

3. 
In the Rule item column, select If contracts are expiring in the next XX days. 

4. 
In the Criteria column, type the number of days before contract expiration to have the 

system notify the users. The contract expiration is based on the End date that you defined in 

the contract record.  

5. 
In the Notify column, select the contract expiration role that you set up. 

6. 
Click Save. 

---

The content of the Contract information page varies depending on whether the record is a 

service contract, a subcontract, or a purchase order, and whether the contract is online (created in 

Bids and Contracts) or offline (created in RealPage Financial Suite). 

• 
The top section of a record contains information about the contract. 

• 
The Bids and contract attachments section lists the files attached to the contract record 

when the contract is an online contract. 

• 
The Create type section is where you select the type of record that you want to create and 

associate with the open record: a purchase order, service contract, or subcontract. 

• 
The (Date) section reflects the type of record that you chose in the Create type section, a 

service contract, subcontract, or purchase order. 

• 
The Documents or Attachment sections allow you to attach a file to the record. The 

Attachments section and drop-down list appears when you do not have scanning enabled. 

The Documents section appears when scanning is enabled. The scanner setting is available 

in My Preferences. 

If the AI contract screening feature is configured, whenever you attach a document to a 

contract record, the system reviews the document for clauses and keywords in the 

document, and then displays the clause information prominently in the contract record. 

• 
When you create a transaction, you can add items in a purchase order, or the job tasks in a 

service contract or subcontract. After you save the transaction, the list does not appear 

when viewing the contract. You must open the transaction to view the list of items. 

After you save the record, additional links appear on the record. The links vary depending on the 

record type and whether your system uses the approval workflow for service contracts, purchase 

orders, and subcontracts:

### Cash Management Section
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 295*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Cash Management Section 

This section of the Finance Agent menu contains AI-enhanced functions from the Cash 

Management application. 

The AI Finance Agent lets you easily streamline your bank reconciliation process.  

Upload your bank statement to have the AI agent: 

• 
Set the statement ending date and balance 

• 
Create corresponding bank transactions 

• 
Generate journal entries for additional activities such as bank fees and interest 

• 
Automatically match bank transactions to G/L transactions 

After uploading a bank statement, the AI agent begins the reconciliation process automatically. If 

the reconciliation is complete and the amount to reconcile is zero, then you can choose to have 

the AI agent submit it for approval automatically. 

---



### Upload Bank Statements
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 296*



#### Before You Begin
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 296*

Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Upload Bank Statements 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Cash Management > Upload Bank Statement`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Cash Management > All > Reconciliation > Upload Bank Statement`


Use this menu option to upload bank statements and create bank feed transactions from them.  

After you upload a bank statement, the AI Finance Agent: 

• 
Sets the statement ending date and balance 

• 
Creates corresponding bank transactions 

• 
Generates journal entries for additional activities such as bank fees and interest 

• 
Automatically matches bank transactions to G/L transactions 

When the bank statement process begins, the system automatically starts the reconciliation. If the 

reconciliation completes with a zero remaining balance, you can choose to have the system 

submit it automatically. 

Before You Begin 

Access can vary depending on your organization’s subscriptions and your permissions. If you do 

not see the option in the menu, then ask your System Administrator to check your permissions. 

These permissions are required to access the Upload Bank Statements page to upload bank 

statements and create bank feed transactions from them: 

Application 
Activities 
Permissions 

Cash Management 
Reconcile Bank 
List, View 

If your user account doesn’t have the permissions shown above, then ask your System 

Administrator for assistance. If you have administrator privileges, you can assign permissions for a 

new feature to a user or to a role. See Roles and Permissions for a description of how to review a 

user’s permissions. 

---



### Upload Bank Statements Page
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 297*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Upload Bank Statements Page 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Cash Management > All > Reconciliation > Upload Bank Statement`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Cash Management > Upload Bank Statement`


Use this page to import a bank statement and create transactions from it. The system reads the 

bank statement, sets the statement ending date and statement ending balance, and then creates 

transactions based on the statement. 

a) Select a bank name and optionally, a property, and then click the Filter button to load the 

Bank Accounts list. 

b) Choose the bank statement that you want by clicking the Choose File button of the desired 

account and property. 

c) Begins the process of uploading the file and creating transactions from it. 

d) Closes the page without uploading a bank statement. 

e) Opens the Uploaded Bank Statements list where you can download the original bank 

statement or view the bank feeds list. 

You must have permissions to reconcile a bank account to upload bank statements. 

---



#### Uploading a Bank Statement
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 298*

Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Uploading a Bank Statement 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Cash Management > All > Reconciliation > Upload Bank Statement`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Cash Management > Upload Bank Statement`


You can upload a bank statement to have the system create bank feed transactions from it. 

To upload a bank statement: 

1. 
Open the Cash Management or Finance Agent menu. 

• 
In the Finance Agent menu, in the Cash Management section, select Upload Bank 

Statement. 

• 
In the Cash Management menu, in the Reconciliation section, select Upload Bank 

Statement. 

The Upload Bank Statements page opens. 

2. 
In the Location/Location Group drop-down list, select a location or location group 

(property or property group) to show the bank accounts you want to upload statements for.  

3. 
Select a bank name in the Bank Name drop-down list. 

4. 
Click the Filter button. The system populates the Bank accounts list. 

Bank accounts that are already in a bank feed configuration or included in the Bank of 
America CashPro connection through the Bank Transaction Interface are not included in 
this list. 

5. 
Click the Choose File button for the bank account that you have a statement for, select the 

statement file, and then click the Open button. 

6. 
Continue selecting Choose File and loading other bank account statements as needed.  

7. 
Click the Upload button. The AI agent processes the bank statements offline.  

You will receive an email after the processing is completed. 

8. 
When you receive the email, review the bank reconciliation and continue reconciling any 

outstanding items. 

---

The Reconcile bank account page opens after you select the account to reconcile and import 

transactions from the Reconciliation box. Use this page to complete the reconciliation, view 

transactions, manually match transactions, unmatch transactions, and create adjusting entries. 

• 
The header shows a summary of the current reconciliation status, including the current book 

balance and the amount left to reconcile. 

• 
The Recon detail section expands to show the full reconciliation details, including the 

matched and unmatched amounts, the Quick match options where you can specify a range 

of checks or transaction document numbers to match multiple transactions at the same 

time, and the filter options for transactions. 

• 
The RealPage and Bank sections display a list of transactions in the system and imported 

transactions, respectively.

Filters 

By default, the Reconcile bank account page displays all transactions for the bank account—both 

matched and unmatched—regardless of the transaction type.  

You can filter the list by state (matched or unmatched), transaction type, bank amount, check or 

document number, and more. See Filtering and Sorting Transactions for more information. 

RealPage vs. Bank Transactions 

The Reconcile bank account page contains two lists of transactions: 

• 
RealPage: This section displays a list of transactions that were entered into RealPage 

Financial Suite directly. 

• 
Bank: This section displays a list of transactions that were imported from a CSV or BAI 

file. It appears only when you have imported transactions. 

Click the Match link to open the Find match page so you can match imported transactions with 

transactions in the system. 

Click the Action link to perform one of the following actions: 

• 
Create JE (on page 303): Create a journal entry when a matching transaction does not exist. 

• 
Exclude: Exclude the transaction from the reconciliation. 

• 
Reconciling (on page 302): Mark a transaction as a reconciling item. 

After you reconcile a bank, you can view reconciling items in the Reconciling items list (on page 

321). 

More Actions 

Click the More actions button in the upper-right corner of the page to perform additional tasks 

during reconciliation: 

• 
Adding bank interest and service charges 

• 
Creating a journal entry 

• 
Adding a manual payment 

• 
Adding a receipt 

• 
Making a deposit 

• 
Transferring funds 

• 
Paying A/P invoices 

• 
Applying payments 

• 
Adding bank transactions 

Each page will open in the form of a pop-up box so you don’t have to leave the Reconcile bank 

account page.

#### Reconciling an Account Manually
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 307*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent 

© 2026 RealPage, Inc. 
RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 

Reconciling an Account Manually 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Cash Management > All > Periodic Tasks > Reconciliation > Bank - New! 
> Continue`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Cash Management > Bank Reconciliation > 
Continue`


If you are matching transactions entered into RealPage Financial Suite against a physical copy of 

your bank statement—or if there are unmatched transactions remaining after importing a bank 

file or auto-matching transactions through reconciliation rules—then you can match the 

transactions manually. RealPage Financial Suite allows you to match transactions on a one-to-one, 

one-to-many, or many-to-many basis. 

The Reconcile bank account page displays two sections from which you can match transactions: 

• 
RealPage: Displays transactions created in the system. 

• 
Bank: Displays imported transactions and retrieved bank feeds. 

Manually Reconciling a Bank Account 

To manually reconcile a bank account: 

1. 
On the Reconcile bank account page, apply filters as needed to filter the list of transactions. 

2. 
In the RealPage section, select the check box next to the RealPage transaction(s) you want 

to match. 

You can match different transaction types on a bank reconciliation if the Remaining 

amount to match field is zero. For example, you can match a single check to a mix of checks 
and deposits or a single deposit to a mix of deposits and checks. This applies only when 
matching transactions on a one-to-many basis, not many-to-many.  

3. 
Click the Match transactions button. 

The system updates the Amount to reconcile field. 

4. 
If the Amount to reconcile field is not zero, you can create adjusting entries, or you can 

save your work, and then complete the reconciliation at a later time. 

5. 
When the Amount to reconcile field is zero, click the Reconcile button to complete the 

reconciliation. 

If bank reconciliations require approval, then click the Submit button. This option is 
available only if you have permission to submit transactions for approval. 

---


<!-- Page 308 -->
Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Manually Reconciling Unmatched Transactions 

If you imported a bank file and there are still unmatched transactions—or if auto-matching was 

not able to match all of your transactions—you can continue manually matching them: 

1. 
Apply filters to display the applicable transactions. 

2. 
Select the check box for an existing transaction, and then click the Match link to open the 

Find match page. 

3. 
On the Find match page, select one or more transactions to match with your transaction, 

and then click the Match button. Alternatively, click the Match and go to next button to go 

to the next available transaction for mapping. 

The system updates the remaining amount to match. 

You can match different transaction types on a bank reconciliation if the amount in the 

Remaining to match field is zero. For example, you can match a single check to a mix of 
checks and deposits or a single deposit to a mix of deposits and checks. The transaction 
amounts do not have to be a one-to-one match as long as the total amount being matched 
is equal.  

4. 
When the Amount to reconcile field is zero, click the Reconcile button to complete the 

reconciliation.  

If bank reconciliations require approval, then click the Submit button. This option is 
available only if you have permission to submit transactions for approval. 

If the Amount to reconcile field is not zero, you can create adjusting entries , or you can 
save your work and complete the reconciliation at a later time. 

---



#### Matching Bank Transactions Without Matching to G/L Transactions
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 309*

Chapter 3: Using the Finance Agent

Matching Bank Transactions Without Matching to G/L Transactions 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Cash Management > All > Periodic Tasks > Reconciliation > Bank - New! 
> Continue`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Cash Management > Bank Reconciliation > 
Continue`


If the balance of your bank account is transferred to a separate account at the end of each day 

and then transferred back the next morning, you will see a record of these ins and outs recorded 

in the Bank section on the Reconcile bank account page, but there won’t be any G/L transactions 

to match them with in the RealPage section. For example, you might see a transaction 

for -120,000 at the end of 12/2, a transaction for 120,000 at the start of 12/3, a transaction 

for -110,000 at the end of 12/3, a transaction for 110,000 at the start of 12/4, and so on. This can 

be cumbersome during bank reconciliations as you will accrue around 60 bank transactions a 

month. To help you quickly clear out these account transfers, RealPage Financial Suite allows you 

to mark the bank transactions as Matched without actually matching them to any G/L 

transactions. 

To quickly clear out bank transactions recorded for account transfers: 

1. 
In the Bank section, select all of the bank transactions you want to clear. You can select 

transactions individually or select the check box in the column header to select all 

transactions at once. 

The Remaining amount to match field changes to reflect the total amount of the selected 

transactions. 

2. 
Click the Match transactions button at the top of the Bank section. 

The State of each transaction changes to Matched. 

---



#### Matching Different Transaction Types if the Amount to Match is Zero
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 310*



#### Matching a Range of Checks (Quick Match)
*Source: `RP Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide.pdf`, Page 310*

Using the Finance Agent 

RealPage Financial Suite AI Finance Agent User Guide 
© 2026 RealPage, Inc.

Matching Different Transaction Types if the Amount to Match is Zero 

You can match different transaction types (i.e. debits and credits) on a bank reconciliation as long 

as the Remaining amount to match is zero. For example, you could match a single check to a mix 

of checks and deposits or a single deposit to a mix of deposits and checks. 

Consider the following scenario: 

• 
One bank transaction—a check in the amount of $3,730.62. 

• 
Three RealPage transactions—a check for $3,653.70, a check for $96.15, and a deposit for 

$19.23. 

Even though the RealPage transactions include a mix of checks and deposits, the system will still 

allow you to match them to the bank transaction because they add up to the same amount, 

$3,730.62. The Remaining amount to match will be zero because the sum totals are equal. 

Matching a Range of Checks (Quick Match) 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Cash Management > All > Periodic Tasks > Reconciliation > Bank - New! 
> Continue`



> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Finance Agent > All > Cash Management > Bank Reconciliation > 
Continue`


Use the Quick match options section of the Reconcile bank account page to match or unmatch all 

of the transactions in a range of checks.  

This feature is not available for bank feeds or transactions that you import in CSV or BAI bank 
files. 

To use quick matching: 

1. 
On the Reconcile bank account page, click and expand the Recon detail section, and then 

find the Quick match options section. 

2. 
In the From check# / doc# field, type the first check number in the range of checks. 

3. 
In the To check# / doc# field, type the last check number in the range of checks. 

4. 
Click the Match button or Unmatch button to match or unmatch the checks.

You can mark imported bank transactions as Reconciling items to exclude them from the 

Amount to reconcile and save them for a future reconciliation period instead. When you 

complete the reconciliation for the bank account, the reconciling items are added to the 

Reconciling items list (on page 321). 

Marking a Transaction as a Reconciling Item 

To mark a transaction as a reconciling item: 

1. 
In the Bank section, find the transaction you want to mark as a reconciling item. 

2. 
Click the Action drop-down list, and then select the Reconciling option. 

When you mark a transaction: 

• 
The transaction is removed from the Find match page.  

• 
The Reconciling (unmatched) amount field is updated to include the transaction 

amount. 

• 
The Ending balance minus reconciling amount field is updated to reflect the new 

balance without the transaction amount. 

Re-Including a Reconciling Item 

Reconciling items remain in the transaction list for the next bank reconciliation period. Click the 

Include link next to the transaction to re-include them when you are ready to match them for 

reconciliation.

Creating a Journal Entry Using the Action Drop-Down List 

After importing bank transactions, the Bank section appears. From here, you can create a journal 

entry for a specific transaction. 

To create a journal entry for a specific bank transaction: 

1. 
In the Bank section, find the transaction for which you want to create a journal entry. 

2. 
Click the Action link, and then select Create JE from the drop-down list. 

The Journal entries page opens with the transaction information already filled in. 

3. 
Complete the information on the Journal entries page, and then click the Post button to 

post the transaction to the General Ledger. You can also save the transaction without 

posting it by clicking the Draft button. 

If the G/L posting date of the journal entry is not within the period that you are currently 
reconciling, then that entry will appear on the bank reconciliation for the next month. 

Adding a Bank Transaction to Include in Your Reconciliation 


> **Navigation Path:** `Applications > Cash Management > All > Periodic Tasks > Reconciliation > Bank - New! 
> More Actions > Add Bank Transaction`


You can quickly add a new bank transaction while reconciling a bank account, such as when you 

need to add reconciling items (on page 302) to be included in your reconciliation. This process 

works the same as if you imported a bank transaction from your bank source. 

To add a bank transaction: 

1. 
On the Reconcile bank account page, click the More actions button in the upper-right 

corner. 

2. 
Select the Add bank transaction option from the drop-down menu. 

The Bank feeds box opens. 

3. 
Fill in the bank transaction details: 

• 
Posting date: Type the G/L posting date for the transaction using any valid date 

format. This is a required field. 

• 
Transaction type: Select the transaction type. This is a required field. 

• 
Document no: For checks, type the check number. For electronic payments, type the 

transaction ID. This is an optional field. 

• 
Amount: Type the transaction amount. Use a leading hyphen (-) to designate any 

negative amounts; for example, -500. This is a required field. 

• 
Payee: Type the name of the payee. This is an optional field. 

• 
Description: Type a description for the transaction. This is an optional field.
